name: Eternal Guardian Style (Combat, Style)
body:
Your combat maneuvers are empowered by psychic curses.

Prerequisites: Intimidate 3 ranks, one Eternal Guardian stance known.

Benefit: Whenever you succeed on a combat maneuver attempt against an opponent, they become cursed for one round. This is a supernatural ability.
